record.name: Peek - AI Personal Finance App
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Peek is the money app that doesn't lecture you. No spreadsheets, no guilt trips, no budgets you'll abandon by Tuesday.

Instead, Peek talks to you. It notices a charge, asks what happened, and helps you see the story behind your spending — the impulse TikTok buy, the Friday coffee ritual, the "while I'm here" spiral. Over time, it learns how you think about money and reflects it back so you actually understand your own patterns.

How it works:

Peek checks in with you about your recent spending through quick, casual conversations. It asks the right questions — not "did you stay under budget?" but "was that worth it to you?" — and builds a picture of your spending behavior that gets sharper over time.

What makes Peek different:

→ Conversations, not spreadsheets
→ Self-awareness, not restrictions
→ Understands your "why," not just your "what"
→ Built for how Gen Z actually relates to money

Peek won't tell you to stop buying oat milk. It'll help you notice that you buy it every time you're stressed — and let you decide what to do with that.

Your money. Your patterns. Your call.

record.name: Mochi: AI Finance Manager
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your money, in plain English.

Mochi Finance brings your accounts, spending, budgets, bills and savings goals into one clear view, then explains what it all means in real sentences written from your own numbers.

SEE YOUR WHOLE PICTURE
Link your bank, card and investment accounts through Plaid and see balances, assets, debts and net worth in one place, with a trend that shows where you're heading.

UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING
See where your money went this week, month, quarter or year. Compare against last period, find your top categories and merchants, and spot what's rising.

BUDGETS THAT KEEP UP
Set a monthly limit for any category and watch your progress as you spend. Refunds are counted, so a returned purchase gives the budget back.

SAVE FOR WHAT MATTERS
Create goals for an emergency fund, a trip or a down payment, add contributions and track progress toward your target date.

NEVER MISS A BILL
Mochi Finance finds your subscriptions and recurring charges, shows what's due next and what they cost you each month and year.

ASK ABOUT YOUR MONEY
Ask questions like "Where did my money go this month?" and get an answer based on your own accounts. Upload statements, tax forms and pay stubs and Mochi Finance reads them and tells you what they say.

READ-ONLY BY DESIGN
Mochi Finance can see your balances and transactions. It cannot move, send or spend money: no payments, transfers, trades or withdrawals. Your bank login is entered inside Plaid's own secure flow and is never seen or stored by Mochi Finance.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
We do not sell your data. AI features are powered by Google Gemini and only run after you agree to it in the app. Decline, and everything else keeps working. Protect the app with Face ID and two-factor authentication, export your data, or delete your account at any time in Settings.

Free, with no paid plans. Account linking depends on supported institutions. AI answers are informational and are not financial, investment, tax or legal advice.

Privacy Policy: https://mochifinance.com/privacy

record.name: Bento: Budget & Money Tracker
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your money. Your priorities. Your Bento.

Bento is a personal finance app that lets you build customizable dashboards around what matters to you — everyday spending, subscriptions, budgets, vacations, projects, and more.

Connect your bank or track money with manual accounts. Import transactions from PDF statements, or log spending with your voice. No bank connection required to get started.

Want to see what your coffee habit actually costs? Create a coffee widget. Planning a vacation? Bring flights, hotels, and spending together in one dashboard. Bento gives you a flexible, visual way to organize your finances around real life.

Meet Benii, your built-in AI assistant. Ask questions about your spending, uncover trends, and get help organizing your finances.

FEATURES

• Customizable dashboards
Build personalized dashboards with flexible in-app widgets. Track accounts, categories, tags, and merchants around your priorities.

• Manual accounts
Track money without linking a bank. Add accounts and transactions yourself, with the flexibility to manage your finances your way.

• PDF statement import
Bring transactions into Bento from PDF statements and spend less time entering them by hand.

• Voice transaction logging
Say what you spent and let Bento help log it. Keep up with everyday purchases without typing out every detail.

• Benii AI assistant
Ask questions about your finances, uncover insights, and get help with transactions, budgets, categories, tags, and rules.

• Subscription & recurring tracking
Spot recurring charges and keep track of upcoming subscriptions before they add up.

• Flexible budgeting
Budget by category or tag — whichever matches the way you think about money.

• Connected accounts
Securely connect your financial accounts through Plaid to bring your finances together in one place.

• Organize spending your way
Use categories, tags, merchant tracking, and custom rules to keep transactions organized.

• Dashboards for real life
Create a dashboard for a vacation, project, event, or spending habit. Choose what to track and the time period that matters to you.

PRIVATE & SECURE

Bank connection is optional. If you choose to connect, Bento uses Plaid, a trusted financial connection provider. Connections are read-only — Bento can never move money or make transactions on your behalf.

Built for the way you think about money.

Privacy Policy: https://www.bentoapp.io/privacy

record.name: finerd.ai • money nerd mode
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
finerd was born out of the need to see all your money in one place. Every account, card, investment and debt comes together in finerd, however complex your finances are. finerd takes over the routine bookkeeping and shows what to change to grow your wealth.

finerd connects through several bank data aggregators and picks the best one for each bank and brokerage in the US, Canada, the UK, Norway and the EU. You can even connect crypto wallets. If a bank won't connect, finerd imports its statements, or your AI adds the transactions via MCP.

Every Apple Pay tap and every payment notification from your bank becomes a transaction in finerd.

finerd categorizes every transaction by context, so a small charge at a gas station goes to coffee and a large one goes to fuel. Fix a category once and finerd applies the fix to similar transactions.

Online orders from email and scanned receipts are split item by item across categories.

Paid cash? Say what you bought and AI adds the transaction.

finerd was built for your AI too. Connect finerd to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and ask "Where can I save?" or "Can I afford a new car?" The AI bases every answer on your transactions in finerd. With your permission, the AI adapts finerd to your goals, creating budgets and categories and adding or editing transactions.

finerd finds subscriptions and recurring payments, so you see which ones to cancel.

Invite a partner, share only the accounts and expenses you choose, and see who paid for what at home. Snap a restaurant receipt and send friends a link where each one picks what they ordered, no app needed. finerd keeps track of who still owes you.

Set budgets by category to see where money leaks.

finerd never sees or stores bank logins and has read-only access to accounts. Delete your data anytime.

Real people answer questions in the app and at support@finerd.ai.

Terms of use: https://finerd.ai/terms-of-use

Privacy policy: https://finerd.ai/privacy-policy

record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Zenmoney is more than just an expense tracker. It’s your personal finance assistant and smart money analyst. It helps you see the full picture, brings clarity to your financial life, and supports your long-term well-being.

Rely on accurate data. When everything is transparent, you can make calm and confident decisions, focused on your real goals and priorities.

Track spending and income automatically
Zenmoney connects all your bank accounts and cards in one place, supporting over 3,300 banks worldwide. It automatically imports and categorises transactions across cards, cash, investments, savings, and even crypto accounts. There’s no need for manual entry — you get a clear, complete picture of your finances at a glance.

You can also customise categories to match your personal needs and enjoy a detailed overview of your spending and income without any routine.

Analyse your spending and understand your habits
Zenmoney helps you see where your money goes each month and compare your spending across different periods. It highlights trends: which categories are growing, which are shrinking, and what impacts your overall budget the most.

You also get a clear balance of income vs expenses, so you can easily spot if your spending starts to outpace your earnings.

The app tracks your savings progress and shows how your reserves change over time — including how many months you could live without income, helping you build a stronger financial cushion.

Get personalised insights with a AI-powered assistant
Zenmoney features an AI assistant that helps you understand your current financial situation, set goals, and create custom analytical charts — even those not included in standard reports.

It can also analyse and compare spending across categories, generate insights for custom time periods, find old transactions, and suggest expenses you might want to optimise. With this personalised support, you gain a deeper understanding of your finances and make more confident decisions.

Plan your budget and stay on top of future spending
With Zenmoney, you can plan your essential expenses or create a full monthly budget. Choose whichever works best for you. You can schedule future calendar payments or set spending limits for specific categories and goals, and the app calculates your overall budget automatically.

You’ll also see how much disposable income is left for spontaneous spending, and easily decide how much to put into virtual saving pots for each goal.

The AI forecasts future spending based on your habits and history and highlights regular payments, upcoming bills, and subscriptions. All of them appear in a simple bill calendar, helping you avoid late fees and stop paying for subscriptions you no longer use.

Bring Zen to your finances
Zenmoney helps you get a clear view of your finances, plan thoughtfully, and feel at ease with your money.

Instead of a traditional “home bookkeeping” approach, Zenmoney acts as your personal finance assistant. It remembers what matters to you, reminds you about upcoming payments, helps you understand spending patterns, and shows how much you can safely spend or save.
